description: RAMMP helps founders and marketers find out why their marketing isn't converting. It computes a free 0-100 Brand Trust Score from a business's own Google Analytics figures and revenue goals, pinpoints the weakest stages of the funnel using the ADORE framework, and returns the highest-impact fixes. A full report tool expands this into per-milestone scores with prescriptive guidance, and a set of helper tools give stage-specific advice for strategy, branding, website, commitment, onboarding, and retention. All tools are read-only: they compute and return guidance from the inputs the user provides and never modify the user's data or any external system.
